answer: A hostile operator must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the umber settlement applies the void retroactively. The canyon edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 93 clones produces a signature the tide analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
